task_summary: Removed flagged incomplete institutional metadata warning alert from submission detail and proposal list; implemented Adviser Defense Readiness Check card enabling assigned project advisers to inspect Chapter 1-3 Proposal Manuscripts and signal 'Ready for Defense', automatically transitioning project defense status to pending_scheduling and notifying Course Instructors, Defense Committee, and Student proponents.
lessons_learned: Lesson: In CMS-V2, approving a manuscript locks it (status = 'locked') to prevent mid-defense tampering. Frontend status cards evaluating approval must recognize both status === 'approved', status === 'locked', and isDefenseReady === true, rather than strictly expecting status === 'approved'.

Lesson: Adding custom notification event types (e.g. 'manuscript_endorsed_for_defense') requires registering the type in server/modules/notifications/notification.model.js NOTIFICATION_TYPES enum to prevent Mongoose validation rejections.
Lesson: Any service-level logger fallback must implement all standard log methods (info, warn, error) to avoid unexpected TypeError: logger.warn is not a function in catch blocks.
